items.title: Russians Vote In First Parliamentary Election Since 2022 Ukraine Invasion
items.description: Russians cast ballots to choose lawmakers for the State Duma, with the more-than-4 ½-year-old war on Ukraine and a slowing economy looming over the country’s first parliamentary elections since the 2022 invasion.

items.title: At least 26 killed in clashes along Sudan-South Sudan border region
items.description: UN Interim Security Force for Abyei strengthens security on the ground after days of deadly fighting.

items.title: A war-fatigued and anxious Russia picks a new parliament
items.description: Fuel shortages, drone strikes and mobilization rumors are fueling anxiety and war fatigue in Russia. As support for peace talks grows among Russians, the Kremlin is watching closely ahead of parliamentary elections.

items.title: U.N.-backed experts cite possible U.S. war crimes in Iran, including a school attack
items.description: Human rights experts commissioned by the U.N. say they have found "reasonable grounds" to believe the U.S. committed war crimes in Iran, including a strike on a school in the southern city of Minab.

items.title: Abducted South African journalist found dead with gunshot wounds
items.description: The body of veteran broadcaster Owen Ndlovu was found hours after armed men kidnapped him near Johannesburg.

items.title: Russia's giant game of Monopoly to fund the war
items.description: 'The Putin System' (3/3). Ever since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, sweeping property redistribution has been underway in Russia. Most often, the state has seized assets from entrepreneurs deemed disloyal and resold them to Vladimir Putin's loyalists.

items.title: For some Israelis, criticizing the military’s conduct in Gaza is beyond the pale
items.description: A new Israeli documentary about the military’s conduct in the Gaza war has brought accusations of “treason” from some of Israel’s leaders.

items.title: Gaza: At least 20 killed in deadly building collapse, search for survivors continues
items.description: Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, according to reports.

items.title: MFA Repeats Warning for Foreign Embassies in Kyiv to Evacuate After Train Strike Near Poland
items.description: The ministry accused Western politicians of “blatantly ignoring” the warnings of their own governments against visiting war-torn Ukraine.
